capabilities: Run an AI agent that searches, reads, creates, edits, moves, and renames vault notes via tool calling
Route chat, summarization, completions, rewrite, web search, deep research, and image generation to per-feature providers
Insert IDE-style inline text completions while typing
Summarize notes into frontmatter and rewrite selected text from custom instructions
Schedule recurring agent tasks and trigger agent runs from vault events
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not Gemini-only; chat, agent, and other features can be routed to Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter providers.
extras: MCP server support is marked experimental; the plugin requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later, and detailed guides live on a separate documentation site referenced from the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use large language models to chat with, search, rewrite, or act on vault notes.

requires.name: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter key (or an OpenAI-compatible server)

summary: AI assistant and tool-calling agent that chats over, searches, and edits your vault using Gemini, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenRouter models.
